title: Three complete applications. Visible results.
intro: Ordinary Bend sources take runtime inputs and produce complete checked outputs. Each application compares its complete process time with upstream-generated C.
clock: Complete generated-application process time, including startup, argument parsing, input, useful work, output capture and shutdown. Compiler requests, Clang builds and oracle generation are excluded.

baseline.reference: Pinned upstream TypeScript compiler emitting C

comparison_note: Both roles compile the same Bend application to C. These are native executable comparisons, not Bend programs versus handwritten TypeScript. Each application keeps its own workload; no cross-application average is reported.

source_refs.title: Applications, output checks and historical build costs

cards.name: Image renderer
cards.description: Render every pixel of a deterministic Mandelbrot image, with explicit row-based parallel work.

preview.alt: Complete Mandelbrot image produced by the native Bend application, showing the fractal against its colored escape-time background.
preview.caption: Actual Phase 100 application output · lossless PNG of the checked PPM

cards.headline: Near upstream speed on one worker.
cards.takeaway: 0.986× upstream time on one worker; 1.195× on four.
cards.note: Four-worker execution remains 19.5% slower than upstream. This measures the complete image and its output, not only the numeric kernel.

cards.headline: 0.912× upstream time on generated source.
cards.takeaway: Indexing the full compiler source takes 1.077× upstream time.
cards.note: This is lexical indexing, not parsing or compiling the source. Compiler-text indexing remains 7.7% slower than upstream; the generated-definition candidate run is short, about 56 ms.

cards.name: Dependency planner
cards.description: Turn runtime graph inputs into a prerequisite-first plan, including shared dependencies, cycles and missing-node diagnostics.

preview.alt: The checked sample dependency graph: core and assets feed lib, ui and harness, which feed app and tests. Seven reachable targets share eight edges.
preview.caption: Diagram of the checked shared.graph fixture · arrows point to consumers

cards.headline: 4.46× upstream speed on the shared graph.
cards.takeaway: The dependency chain runs 4.07× as fast as upstream-generated C.
cards.note: The planner remains serial and uses linear lookup. Its backend win does not remove the algorithm’s worst-case quadratic or O(VE) scaling.

history.title: Historical parallel-scaling check
history.note: This older campaign uses Phase 98-generated programs; it is separate from current candidate04’s one/four-worker comparison. Every worker setting produces the identical complete image.

parallel_scaling.scope: Pooled nine observations per role/worker; physical cores; GPU off. Complete process clock. Single-tile control has no row forks.

qualification.note: Historical application delivery covers 50 independent oracle inputs; current candidate04 timing separately checks 72 complete outputs over six performance points. These counts describe different campaigns and are not added.
